entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a helmet. I want my money back, and I want it back now. This is unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

The issue is I don't want it! The color is hideous, my wife says it looks ridiculous. What does it matter? The point is the box unopened, it's brand new. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand your frustration, and I can definitely assist you with this. A manager won't be necessary. To proceed, I just need to pull up your order. Do you have the order number handy?
Ugh, fine. It's VF-987654. Just hurry up. If this becomes a whole thing, I'm lighting you guys up on every review site I can find.
Thank you for that number. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the Trail Helmet, delivered about 66 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Here we go. I knew it. The runaround.

Not at all. My system confirms that you are well within the 90-day return window. Since you've confirmed the box is unopened and the helmet is in new condition, I can approve this return for a full refund right now. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities.
Wait, really? That's it? You're just approving it?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I am sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the package, and you can drop it off at any carrier location.
Oh. Wow. Okay, I was expecting a huge fight. That's... actually really easy. Thank you, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
